title: 第2660章 冰火圣纹第2659章 打碎冰雕
content_zh:
随着时间的推移，林尘遇到的冰雕越来越多了。每一只冰雕都爆发出惊人的战力，寒冰道则所化的攻击如同暴风雪般连绵不绝，冰刃破空、寒霜铺地，换作寻常天骄早就被这源源不断的冰雕耗尽了体力。然而那些冰雕在林尘面前，说实话已然无法造成太大的威胁。
林尘看到冰雕，根本不与它们过多纠缠，直接一记狂猛的冰火杀招招呼过去，冰火融合之力在虚空中炸开，炽烈与极寒交织，冰雕表面的符文瞬间暗淡，庞大的身躯随即轰然融化，连挣扎的机会都没有。冰火融合之力在他手中施展出来，如有神助，每一击都恰到好处地击在冰雕最为脆弱的符文节点之上。
林尘解决那些冰雕的速度一如既往的快。没多久，便有五只冰雕同时出现在他面前，呈半圆形将去路封死，寒气交织成一片白茫茫的雾障。然而这阵仗对林尘而言不过是一道稍大些的开胃菜，片刻功夫，五只冰雕便被他轰成了漫天碎渣。
冰雕当中蕴含的寒冰本源之力如同找到归处一般，化作一道道幽蓝色的光流尽数灌注到林尘体内，浸润他的经脉，沉淀到丹田深处，毫无疑问地成了他冰系道则的养料。林尘周身的气息在寒冰本源的滋养下日益壮大，体内仿佛凝聚出了一颗永不融化的寒冰核心，每一次呼吸都吐出一缕淡淡的白雾。
到后来，林尘面前直接出现了九具冰雕。九具冰雕一字排开，巍然矗立，身上散发出的气息波动比此前遇到的所有冰雕加起来都要惊人，仿佛九座即将崩塌的冰山同时悬在头顶。林尘心中有了判断——这九具冰雕，应该就是这片冰天雪地的终极考验了。不仅在数量上达到了极致，每一尊冰雕所散发出的威压也是空前绝后的强大，那寒冰之气凝练到几乎化为实质，连光线穿过它们身周时都被扭曲折射。这些冰雕不仅拥有令人窒息的寒冰之力，更擅长合击之道，它们的站位看似松散，实则暗合某种玄奥的阵法轨迹，彼此之间的气息相互勾连，攻其一便会引来九方的联合反扑。想要收拾它们，绝对不是一件容易的事。
感知到九尊冰雕身上传来的恐怖压力，林尘不紧不慢，掌心之中一朵冰火之莲缓缓凝聚成型。与此同时，他的另一只手掌上也悄然绽放出一朵血渊火莲。两朵莲花在他双掌之间交相辉映，一朵冰火交融，一朵纯粹炽烈，截然不同的光芒将他的脸庞映照得忽明忽暗。冰火之莲与血渊火莲同时出场，这还是林尘头一次同时驾驭两种截然不同的火莲——既然九尊冰雕值得他认真对待，那他自然也要拿出些像样的手段。
此时林尘不知道的是，那些与他一同进入第三轮考核的天骄们，一个个都颇为凄惨。他们面对冰雕的攻击左支右绌，险象环生，绝大多数人连一只冰雕都无法击败，便已经耗尽了体力被迫退出。有的人被冻得浑身僵紫，连剑都握不稳；有的人拼尽全力击碎了半座冰雕，却发现冰雕很快便自行修复如初，绝望之下只得放弃。他们的表现跟林尘比起来，差距不是一般的大，简直一个在天一个在地。反观林尘，此刻已经站在了第三轮考核最关键的一环——同时面对九尊冰雕。他却始终面色淡然，呼吸平稳，仿佛眼前的九座冰山不过是九座稍大些的冰坨子。
九只冰雕与林尘展开了激烈鏖战，寒冰与火焰的碰撞声此起彼伏，冰屑与火星在虚空中疯狂交织。令人惊叹的是，林尘从头到尾没有施展其他手段，纯粹依靠自己所领悟的冰火融合之力，便与九尊冰雕斗得旗鼓相当，进而逐渐占据上风。
其实林尘若是依靠自己的肉身力量来硬撼，收拾这些冰雕会更容易一些——以他如今真我神龙级别的肉身强度，一拳下去便能将冰雕轰碎半边。但他偏偏没有这么做，准确来说，几乎是完全不动用肉身之力，全凭自己对冰火融合之道的感悟来应对。那恐怖的寒冰道则袭来时，他不强行抵抗，而是顺着寒气的流转方向将其牵引，如同太极推手般将那股力量导入体内，再凭借对冰系功法的深刻理解将其中的本源力量一一吸收炼化。这种做法比直接打爆冰雕要慢得多，也比动用肉身之力硬撼要凶险得多，但林尘觉得这样才是最有价值的历练方式——他来这里不是为了闯关，而是为了借这些冰雕来锤炼自己的冰火融合之道。
而事实上，一直在虚空中默默观战的血渊神龙也认为林尘的办法非常完美。他活过了漫长岁月，见过太多天骄仗着蛮力一路碾压，最终虽然通过了考核却错失了最珍贵的感悟。唯有像林尘这样，以道御敌、以悟为战，才能真正在这片冰天雪地中得到足够深厚的好处，让自己的冰火融合之道爆发出更加恐怖的威能。血渊神龙越看越满意，龙瞳中满是赞许。
林尘嘴角始终含着一抹笑意，从容不迫。经过连续数日的鏖战，九只冰雕终于被他逐一击破，每一尊冰雕在崩溃的瞬间都化作精纯的寒冰本源能量，如百川归海般涌入他体内，成为他冰系本源力量最坚实的根基。当最后一尊冰雕在他面前轰然碎裂时，漫天冰屑在寒风中旋舞而下，折射出万道细碎的光芒，如同一场盛大的冰雪葬礼。
至此，血渊神龙的考核告一段落。他将三轮考核中所有人的表现尽收眼底，心中已没有半分犹豫——除了林尘之外，确实没有任何人比他更适合得到这份传承。这个年轻人不仅天赋无双，更难能可贵的是那颗懂得用脑子修炼的心。
考核结束后，林尘与血渊神龙单独面对面而立。血渊神龙的意志化身此时已极为凝实，龙首低垂，龙瞳中闪烁着复杂的光芒。沉默片刻后，他忽然开口，语气中带着几分追忆与审视：“你可知道，我与光明教是什么关系？”
林尘微微一怔，摇了摇头：“不知。”
“光明教的祖师爷，曾经与我有旧，我是他的至交好友。”血渊神龙缓缓说道，目光似乎穿透了重重时空，回到了某个遥远而古老的岁月，“因此，我便留在这血渊秘境中，为光明教的那些后辈天骄提供历练的机会，也算是对故友的一点交代。”
“原来如此。”林尘点了点头，随即坦然说道，“不过我杀了光明教不少人。若前辈要追究，晚辈也无话可说。”
既然血渊神龙与光明教有这层关系，那他若是有心去查，迟早能查到林尘与光明教之间的血海深仇。与其等对方察觉之后再心生隔阂，倒不如林尘主动说出来，坦坦荡荡。林尘本以为血渊神龙会很惊讶，甚至与他当场翻脸，但出乎他意料的是，血渊神龙表现得极为平静，那张龙脸上没有半分怒意，反而露出了一抹意味深长的笑意。
“你也不必紧张。”血渊神龙缓缓摇头，“我与光明教那位祖师爷的交情，在当年确实不错，称得上是肝胆相照。但岁月太过久远，故人早已化作尘土，如今的我跟光明教教主谈不上有多深的交情，说到底不过是因着一份旧约留在此地罢了。即便你杀了光明教的人，只要你适合得到我的传承，我也绝不会有半分犹豫。这传承是你的，便是你的，谁也夺不走。”
血渊神龙顿了顿，语气忽然变得郑重起来：“我之所以告诉你我与光明教的关系，并非要追责于你，而是希望你在得到我的传承之后，有朝一日能够执掌光明教，带领光明教征战诡异一族。光明圣城本就是一处征战诡异族的战略要地，只是如今经历了漫长的和平岁月，那些年轻修行者们似乎早已忘了光明圣城最初存在的意义。我看如今光明教的那些老东西，争权夺利倒是一把好手，对征战诡异族却并不怎么上心，长此以往，光明圣城迟早会丢了魂。”
闻言，林尘的神色也变得严肃了几分，他郑重地点了点头：“这一点你大可放心，我本就是要成为光明圣城新的主人，执掌光明圣城的。诡异一族若敢来犯，我自会让他们有来无回。”

“好，有志气！”血渊神龙龙瞳一亮，声音中满是激赏，“我看好你。那么事不宜迟，接下来我便将我的传承正式交给你。”
他略微停顿，随即语气中多了几分傲然：“冰火创世诀，乃是我诸多绝技当中威力最强的一种。冰火融合之道修炼起来难度极高，你如今虽然已掌握了冰火融合之力，能自行将冰与火融为一体，威力也算不俗，但我看得出来，你的运用之法完全是出自自己的感悟与摸索，缺少一套成体系的功法作为根基。自行领悟固然难得，却终究会走不少弯路。而我的冰火创世诀，对你而言无疑是再合适不过的。”
闻言，林尘深以为然地点了点头。血渊神龙这番话说到了他的心坎里——他的冰火融合之力威力虽强，但施展起来总有一种“野路子”的感觉，缺少系统性的引导和更高层次的运用法门。血渊神龙的冰火创世诀若是不给他修炼，那绝对是天大的浪费。这门功法简直像是为他量身定制的一般，林尘非要把它研究透彻不可。
当下血渊神龙也没有半分犹豫，伸出龙爪轻轻一指点在林尘眉心，将冰火创世诀的全部修行法门尽数灌入林尘识海之中。庞大的信息量如同决堤的洪流般涌入，每一个文字都泛着古朴的光芒，在林尘识海中排列成一篇玄奥无比的功法总纲。传功之际，血渊神龙又缓缓开口补充道：“这门功法其实并非由我所创。我昔年与诡异族征战之时，偶然闯入一处洞天福地，才得到了这份天大的机缘。冰火创世诀具体的功法等级，连我也无法确切判断，只知道它比绝大多数真我级别的功法都要厉害太多。具体高到什么层次，留待你日后慢慢考证。不过那也不重要了，你只需记住——冰火创世诀，是远超真我级别的功法，这便足够了。”
血渊神龙话音落下时，关于冰火创世诀的完整修行法门已彻底烙印在林尘的识海深处。林尘闭目消化了片刻，将功法总纲从头到尾粗略过了一遍，脸上顿时浮现出一抹灿烂的笑容。
冰火创世诀确实是一门档次极高的功法，其核心在于将冰与火的融合之力在体内不断凝练，最终凝聚出一种名为“冰火圣纹”的特殊印记。通过冰火圣纹中所蕴含的冰火融合之力，便可释放出这一功法的最强杀招——冰火创世莲。与林尘此前凭自己摸索创造出的冰火之莲相比，冰火创世莲的威力明显要高出一个档次，二者根本不属于一个级别。而冰火创世莲威力的关键，就在于冰火圣纹的数量，凝聚出的冰火圣纹越多，冰火创世莲的威力便越恐怖。这一点与林尘的龙族天赋颇为相似——真我神龙纹越多，龙族手段的战力便越强。
然而修炼冰火创世诀的第一步，便是要凝聚出冰火圣纹。想要凝聚冰火圣纹，需要的是对这门功法最深刻的领悟，若不能参透其中蕴含的冰火奥义，想凝聚出哪怕一道圣纹都是痴人说梦，必然困难重重。林尘将功法总纲仔细研读了一遍，只觉得其中字字珠玑，每一句都蕴含着无穷的玄机，绝非一朝一夕能够参透。
不过林尘对自己的悟性向来极有信心，况且他在冰火融合之道上本就有着坚实的基础，如今修炼冰火创世诀，理论上来说应当颇为顺畅。即便有一些磕绊，也不过是时间问题罢了。但让林尘真正头疼的是——修炼这门功法需要消耗的资源实在太多了，多到了一个令人瞠目结舌的地步。首先需要永恒冰晶，其次需要永恒火晶，这两种极为珍贵的修炼资源缺一不可。而仅仅是凝炼出第一道冰火圣纹，所需要的永恒冰晶和永恒火晶的数量便极其可观，后面的每一道圣纹更是呈倍数增长。说白了，这门功法简直就是一头吞金巨兽，不是真正的暴发户，根本不配修炼。
林尘将冰火创世诀的修行法门从头到尾看完一遍，随即便眼巴巴地看向了血渊神龙，那眼神中的意味不言自明。
血渊神龙被他看得浑身不自在，皱了皱眉，没好气地说道：“你看我做什么？”
林尘撇了撇嘴，理所当然地说道：“还能做什么？修炼冰火创世诀需要的资源，我是一点都没有，巧妇难为无米之炊，这功法再好，没资源也只能干瞪眼。”
林尘摊了摊手，脸上露出了一抹无奈的苦笑。他倒不是在装穷——永恒冰晶和永恒火晶那种东西，他之前确实接触过，但品级和数量都远远达不到冰火创世诀的最低要求。
见状，血渊神龙无奈地叹了口气：“资源嘛，我倒是有一些。你想要资源直说便是，何必拐弯抹角。我既然将冰火创世诀的修行法门传给了你，自然不会吝啬这点资源，否则传了功法却不给修炼的资粮，岂不是白白浪费了你我的时间。”
血渊神龙轻哼一声，龙爪一挥，十块永恒火晶与十块永恒冰晶便凭空出现在林尘面前，整齐地悬浮在半空中。永恒火晶通体赤红，内部仿佛封存着一团永不熄灭的烈焰，散发出灼热而澎湃的气息；永恒冰晶则晶莹剔透，寒气内敛，表面缭绕着一层薄薄的白雾，仿佛将整座冰川的寒意都压缩在了这方寸之间。两种晶石交相辉映，冰与火的光芒在林尘眼前交织成一片瑰丽的景象。
林尘以前确实得到过类似的资源，但与此刻手中这些永恒冰晶和永恒火晶相比，以前那些简直不值一提。无论纯度还是其中蕴含的本源之力，都不是一个档次的东西。光是握在手中，林尘便能感受到永恒冰晶与永恒火晶中散发出的冰火融合的原始力量，那股力量强横到令人窒息的地步。别的不说，单凭这份修炼资源，就不是一般天骄能得到的——放眼整个光明圣城，恐怕也只有内城中那些一流势力的核心弟子，才有资格接触到这般珍贵的修炼材料。而血渊神龙一出手便是整整二十块，这份手笔，不可谓不大。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
As time went by, Lin Chen encountered more and more ice sculptures. Each ice sculpture burst out with astonishing combat power, and the attacks made by the Ice Dao were as continuous as a blizzard. Ice blades broke through the air and frost covered the ground. An ordinary genius would have been exhausted by this steady stream of ice sculptures. However, in front of Lin Chen, those ice sculptures could no longer pose much of a threat.
When Lin Chen saw the ice sculptures, he didn't get too entangled with them at all. He directly greeted them with a fierce ice and fire killing move. The fusion of ice and fire exploded in the void, blazing and extremely cold. The runes on the surface of the ice sculptures dimmed instantly, and the huge body immediately melted, without even a chance to struggle. The power of the fusion of ice and fire was unleashed in his hands. With divine help, every blow hit the most vulnerable rune node of the ice sculpture just right.
Lin Chen solved those ice sculptures as fast as ever. Not long after, five ice sculptures appeared in front of him at the same time, blocking the way in a semicircle, and the cold air intertwined into a white fog barrier. However, this battle was just a slightly bigger appetizer to Lin Chen. In just a moment, he blasted the five ice sculptures into pieces.
The original power of ice contained in the ice sculpture seemed to have found its home, turning into streams of faint blue light and pouring into Lin Chen's body, infiltrating his meridians and settling into the depths of his Dantian. It undoubtedly became the nourishment for his ice system. The aura around Lin Chen was growing stronger and stronger under the nourishment of the ice source. It seemed that a core of ice that would never melt was condensed in his body, and a faint white mist was exhaled with every breath.
Later, nine ice sculptures appeared directly in front of Lin Chen. The nine ice sculptures were lined up in a row, standing majestically, and the aura fluctuations emanating from them were more amazing than all the ice sculptures encountered before combined, as if nine icebergs about to collapse were hanging overhead at the same time. Lin Chen made a judgment in his mind - these nine ice sculptures should be the ultimate test in this land of ice and snow. Not only did they reach the extreme in terms of quantity, but the pressure exuded by each ice sculpture was also unprecedentedly powerful. The ice energy was condensed to the point where it almost turned into substance, and even the light was distorted and refracted when it passed through them. These ice sculptures not only possess the suffocating power of ice, they are also good at combined attacks. Their positions may seem loose, but in fact they coincide with some mysterious formation trajectory. Their auras are connected with each other. Attacking one of them will trigger a joint counterattack from nine directions. It is definitely not an easy task to clean them up.
Sensing the terrifying pressure coming from the nine ice sculptures, Lin Chen took his time and slowly formed a lotus of ice and fire in his palm. At the same time, a Blood Abyss Fire Lotus quietly bloomed on his other palm. Two lotus flowers reflected each other between his palms, one blended with ice and fire, the other pure and blazing, and completely different lights illuminated his face. The Ice and Fire Lotus and the Blood Abyss Fire Lotus appeared at the same time. This was the first time that Lin Chen controlled two completely different fire lotuses at the same time. Since the nine ice sculptures deserved his serious treatment, he would naturally have to come up with some decent means.
What Lin Chen didn't know at this time was that the geniuses who entered the third round of assessment with him were all quite miserable. They were overwhelmed by the attacks from the ice sculptures and were surrounded by dangers. Most of them could not defeat even one ice sculpture, so they had exhausted their physical strength and were forced to withdraw. Some people were so frozen that they could not even hold their swords firmly; some people tried their best to smash half of the ice sculpture, only to find that the ice sculpture quickly repaired itself and had to give up in despair. Compared with Lin Chen's performance, the gap between them was not that big. One was in the sky and the other was on the ground. On the other hand, Lin Chen was now standing in the most critical part of the third round of assessment - facing nine ice sculptures at the same time. However, he always looked calm and breathed steadily, as if the nine icebergs in front of him were just nine slightly larger ice lumps.
The nine ice sculptures and Lin Chen unfoldedThere was a fierce battle, the sounds of collisions of ice and flames came one after another, and ice chips and sparks intertwined crazily in the void. What's amazing is that Lin Chen didn't use any other means from the beginning to the end, relying solely on the power of the fusion of ice and fire that he understood, and he was able to fight evenly with the nine ice sculptures, and gradually gained the upper hand.
In fact, it would be easier for Lin Chen to deal with these ice sculptures if he relied on his own physical strength - with his current physical strength at the level of the true dragon, he could break half of the ice sculptures with one punch. But he didn't do this. To be precise, he almost didn't use the physical power at all and relied entirely on his own understanding of the fusion of ice and fire to deal with it. When the terrifying ice path struck, he did not resist forcefully, but pulled it along the direction of the flow of cold air. He introduced the power into his body like a Tai Chi pusher, and then relied on his deep understanding of the ice system to absorb and refine the original power one by one. This method is much slower than directly blowing up the ice sculptures, and is much more dangerous than using physical force to shake them, but Lin Chen feels that this is the most valuable way to gain experience - he is not here to break through the levels, but to use these ice sculptures to hone his fusion of ice and fire.
In fact, Blood Abyss Dragon, who had been watching the battle silently in the void, also believed that Lin Chen's method was perfect. He has lived for a long time and has seen too many geniuses crushing them with brute strength. In the end, although he passed the test, he missed the most precious insights. Only someone like Lin Chen, who uses Dao to defend his enemies and fights with enlightenment, can truly gain deep enough benefits in this world of ice and snow, allowing his fusion of ice and fire to unleash even more terrifying power. The Blood Abyss Dragon looked more and more satisfied, its eyes filled with approval.
Lin Chen always had a smile on his lips, taking his time calmly. After several days of fierce fighting, he finally defeated the nine ice sculptures one by one. At the moment of collapse, each ice sculpture turned into pure ice energy, which poured into his body like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, becoming the most solid foundation of his ice origin power. When the last ice sculpture shattered in front of him, ice shards swirled down in the cold wind, reflecting thousands of tiny rays of light, like a grand ice and snow funeral.
At this point, the assessment of the Blood Abyss Dragon has come to an end. He had a panoramic view of everyone's performance in the three rounds of assessments, and there was no hesitation in his heart - except for Lin Chen, there was really no one more suitable than him to receive this inheritance. Not only is this young man unparalleled in talent, but what is even more valuable is his heart that knows how to use his brain to practice.
After the assessment, Lin Chen and the Blood Abyss Dragon stood face to face alone. The incarnation of the blood abyss dragon's will is now extremely solidified, the dragon's head is lowered, and the dragon's pupils are shining with complex light. After a moment of silence, he suddenly spoke, with a hint of recollection and scrutiny in his tone: "Do you know what my relationship is with the Guangming Sect?"
Lin Chen was slightly startled and shook his head: "I don't know."
"The founder of the Guangming Sect once had an old relationship with me, and I was his close friend." The Blood Abyss Dragon said slowly, his eyes seeming to have penetrated through time and space, returning to a distant and ancient time. "Therefore, I stay in this secret realm of the Blood Abyss to provide opportunities for the talents of the younger generations of the Guangming Sect to gain experience, which can be regarded as a token of appreciation for my old friend."
"I see." Lin Chen nodded, and then said calmly, "But I killed many people from the Guangming Sect. If the seniors want to pursue the case, the juniors have nothing to say."
Since the Blood Abyss Dragon has this relationship with the Guangming Sect, if he is determined to investigate, sooner or later he will be able to find out the blood feud between Lin Chen and the Guangming Sect. Rather than wait for the other party to notice and then become estranged, it would be better for Lin Chen to speak out openly and openly. Lin Chen originally thought that the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon would be surprised and even fall out with him on the spot, but to his surprise, the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon acted extremely calmly. There was no trace of anger on the dragon's face, but a meaningful smile."You don't have to be nervous." Blood Abyss Dragon slowly shook his head, "My friendship with the founder of the Guangming Sect was really good back then, and it can be said to be a sincere relationship. But the years have passed so long that our old friends have long since turned into dust. Now I can't talk to the leader of the Guangming Sect. What a deep friendship we have, in the final analysis, it is just because of an old covenant. Even if you kill people from the Guangming Sect, as long as you are suitable to get my inheritance, I will never hesitate at all. This inheritance is yours, and no one can take it away. "
The Blood Abyss Dragon paused, and his tone suddenly became solemn: "The reason why I told you about my relationship with the Guangming Religion is not to hold you responsible, but to hope that after receiving my inheritance, you can one day take charge of the Guangming Religion and lead the Guangming Religion to fight against the strange clan. The Holy City of Light is originally a strategy to conquer the strange clan. Important place, but now that we have experienced a long period of peace, those young practitioners seem to have forgotten the original meaning of the Holy City of Light. I think those old people in the Guangming Sect are good at fighting for power, but they are not very interested in conquering the strange tribe. If this continues, the Holy City of Light will lose its soul sooner or later. "
Hearing this, Lin Chen's expression became a little more serious. He nodded solemnly: "You can rest assured about this. I am originally going to become the new master of the Holy City of Light and take charge of the Holy City of Light. If the Weird Clan dares to invade, I will make it impossible for them to come back."
"Okay, you are ambitious!" The Blood Abyss Divine Dragon's eyes lit up, and his voice was full of appreciation, "I am optimistic about you. Then without further ado, I will officially hand over my inheritance to you."
He paused slightly, and then his tone became more arrogant: "The Creation Art of Ice and Fire is the most powerful among my many special skills. The fusion of ice and fire is extremely difficult to practice. Although you have mastered the power of fusion of ice and fire now, you can fuse ice and fire on your own, and your power is also It's not bad, but I can see that your method of application is entirely based on your own understanding and exploration, and there is no systematic method as a foundation. Although it is difficult to understand it on your own, it will eventually lead to many detours, and my Ice and Fire Creation Technique is undoubtedly perfect for you. "
Hearing this, Lin Chen nodded with deep understanding. The words of the Blood Abyss Dragon spoke to his heart - although his ice and fire fusion power was powerful, it always felt like a "wild way" when used, lacking systematic guidance and higher-level application techniques. It would be a huge waste if he was not allowed to practice the Ice and Fire Creation Technique of the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon. This technique seemed to be tailor-made for him, and Lin Chen had to study it thoroughly.
At that moment, the Blood Abyss Divine Dragon did not hesitate at all. He stretched out his dragon claw and pointed lightly at the center of Lin Chen's eyebrows, pouring all the training methods of the Ice and Fire Creation Art into Lin Chen's sea of ​​consciousness. The huge amount of information poured in like a torrent that burst a dam, and every word was glowing with ancient light, arranged in Lin Chen's sea of ​​consciousness to form an extremely mysterious general outline of the technique. As he was passing on the technique, Blood Abyss Dragon slowly added: "This technique was not actually created by me. When I was fighting against the strange tribe in the past, I accidentally broke into a cave paradise and got this great opportunity. Even I can't confirm the specific level of the Ice and Fire Creation Technique. All I know is that it is much more powerful than most True Self-level techniques. I will leave it to you to verify later. But that is not important. You only need to remember that the Ice and Fire Creation Technique is far beyond the True Self-level techniques."
When the Blood Abyss Dragon finished speaking, the complete practice method of Ice and Fire Creation Technique had been completely imprinted in the depths of Lin Chen's sea of consciousness. Lin Chen closed his eyes and digested it for a moment, briefly going through the general outline of the technique from beginning to end, and a bright smile suddenly appeared on his face.
Ice and Fire Creation Technique is indeed a very high-level skill, and its core lies inThe fusion power of ice and fire is continuously condensed in the body, and finally a special mark called "Ice and Fire Sacred Pattern" is condensed. Through the fusion power of ice and fire contained in the ice and fire holy patterns, the most powerful killing move of this technique can be released - Ice and Fire Creation Lotus. Compared with the Ice and Fire Lotus that Lin Chen had created on his own before, the Ice and Fire Creation Lotus was obviously a level higher in power. The two were not at the same level at all. The key to the power of the Ice and Fire Creation Lotus lies in the number of ice and fire holy patterns. The more ice and fire holy patterns are condensed, the more terrifying the power of the Ice and Fire Creation Lotus will be. This is quite similar to Lin Chen's dragon talent - the more true dragon patterns there are, the stronger the dragon's combat power will be.
However, the first step in practicing the Ice and Fire Creation Art is to condense the Ice and Fire Holy Marks. If you want to condense the holy pattern of ice and fire, you need the deepest understanding of this technique. If you can't understand the secret of ice and fire contained in it, trying to condense even one holy pattern is just a dream, and it will be difficult. Lin Chen carefully read the general outline of the technique, and felt that every word and every sentence contained endless mysteries, which could not be understood overnight.
However, Lin Chen has always been very confident in his own understanding. Moreover, he already has a solid foundation in the fusion of ice and fire. Now practicing the ice and fire creation art should be quite smooth in theory. Even if there are some setbacks, it's just a matter of time. But what really bothered Lin Chen was that practicing this technique required too many resources, to a jaw-dropping level. First, you need eternal ice crystals, and secondly, you need eternal fire crystals. These two extremely precious cultivation resources are indispensable. And just to condense the first ice and fire holy pattern, the amount of eternal ice crystals and eternal fire crystals required is extremely considerable, and each subsequent holy pattern increases exponentially. To put it bluntly, this technique is simply a gold-swallowing giant beast. It is not a real nouveau riche, and it is not worthy of practicing at all.
Lin Chen read the practice method of Ice and Fire Creation Technique from beginning to end, and then looked eagerly at the Blood Abyss Dragon. The meaning in his eyes was self-explanatory.
Blood Abyss Divine Dragon felt uncomfortable looking at him, frowned, and said angrily: "What do you think I'm doing?"
Lin Chen curled his lips and said matter-of-factly: "What else can I do? I don't have any resources needed to practice the Ice and Fire Creation Technique. A clever woman can't make a building without rice. No matter how good this technique is, if you don't have the resources, you can only stare at it."
Lin Chen spread his hands, with a helpless smile on his face. He was not pretending to be poor - he had indeed come into contact with things like eternal ice crystals and eternal fire crystals before, but the grade and quantity were far from the minimum requirements of the Ice and Fire Creation Art.
Seeing this, Blood Abyss Dragon sighed helplessly: "Resources, I do have some. If you want resources, just say so, why bother beating around the bush. Since I have passed on the practice method of Ice and Fire Creation Technique to you, I will naturally not be stingy with these resources. Otherwise, if I pass on the method but do not give you the training materials, wouldn't it be a waste of your and my time."
The Blood Abyss Divine Dragon snorted softly, and with a wave of its claws, ten eternal fire crystals and ten eternal ice crystals appeared out of thin air in front of Lin Chen, suspended neatly in mid-air. The eternal fire crystal is red in color, and there seems to be an eternal flame sealed inside, exuding a scorching and surging atmosphere; the eternal ice crystal is crystal clear, and the cold air is restrained, with a thin layer of white mist lingering on the surface, as if the coldness of the entire glacier is compressed into this square inch. The two kinds of crystals complemented each other, and the light of ice and fire intertwined into a magnificent scene before Lin Chen's eyes.
Lin Chen had indeed obtained similar resources before, but compared with the eternal ice crystals and eternal fire crystals in his hands now, those before were simply nothing. No matter the purity or the original power contained in it, they are not of the same grade. Just by holding it in his hand, Lin Chen could feel the eternal ice crystals and eternal fire.The raw power of the fusion of ice and fire emanating from the crystal was so powerful that it was suffocating. Apart from anything else, this cultivation resource alone is not something that ordinary geniuses can obtain - looking at the entire Holy City of Light, I am afraid that only the core disciples of the first-rate forces in the inner city are qualified to have access to such precious cultivation materials. And the Blood Abyss Dragon cost a full twenty yuan, which is not a big deal.
